Accomplishment
1. Served twice as the president of Taiwanese Association of East Tennessee.

2. Served once as the president of San Diego Taiwanese Cultural Association.

3. A board member of the Taiwanese American Foundation of San Diego and served as the president for one year.

4. Continues to be a volunteer of the Taiwanese American Community Center of San Diego.
